name: Naked-stem lomatium
desc: Naked-stem lomatium (Lomatium nudicaule): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 20 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lomatium nudicaule is a species of flowering plant in the carrot family known by the common names barestem biscuitroot, pestle lomatium, desert parsley, Indian celery, and Indian consumption plant.
